name: Amazon cooperative cloud computing center / AWS Ningxia (Western Cloud Base)
developer: Amazon Web Services with local Zhongwei/Ningxia partners (NWCD/Xiyun Data operator)
notes: Zhongwei government page lists the Amazon cooperative cloud computing center among large data centers built and operating in the Western Cloud Base; Amazon material confirms the Ningxia region operated by Xiyun Data (NWCD) came online December 2017. MW not published.

name: China Mobile Ningxia Zhongwei Data Center A/B parks
notes: People's Daily app reports China Mobile's Zhongwei data center has over RMB10bn cumulative investment, nine machine-room buildings and 76,500 racks in service; Zhongwei government lists it operating. Zhongwei has built nine DC industrial parks, 26 DC enterprises and 8 central-ministry disaster-recovery DCs per 2026-05 local reporting.

name: China Telecom Zhongwei Data Center
notes: Zhongwei government lists China Telecom Data Center as built and operating; a 2021 government reply reports phase-one buildings had completed main steel structure with electromechanical work progressing. MW not disclosed.

name: China Unicom Ningxia Zhongwei Data Center
notes: China Daily described construction and planned delivery of China Unicom's Zhongwei data center in 2020; Zhongwei government later listed it as built and operating. MW not disclosed.

name: China Brain Green Data Center, Zhongwei Western Cloud Base
developer: China Brain / Zhongguo Danao project parties
notes: Zhongwei government lists China Brain Green Data Center among six built and operating large/super-large data centers in the Western Cloud Base. MW not disclosed.

name: Ningxia Meili Cloud data center, Zhongwei Western Cloud Base
notes: Zhongwei government page lists Ningxia Meili Cloud Data Center as built and operating; trade/financial coverage says Meiliyun built eight IDC buildings in Zhongwei with 19,200 cabinets; MW not stated.

name: CCCC Zhongwei Cloud Data Center Project Phase I
notes: Zhongwei key-project table lists CCCC Zhongwei cloud data center phase I as continued construction, with 11 data-center buildings and 15,800 8 kW racks; capacity_mw calculated as 15,800 x 8 kW = 126.4 MW.

name: ZData/CICC Data Zhongwei Zero-Carbon Computing Industry Base
notes: People's Daily Ningxia reports the project started in May 2025, planned RMB40bn investment, about 2,266 mu, 820,000 standard racks, and total IT load about 2,050 MW; phase one is about 700 MW.

name: Jinko Power Zhongwei 1 GW green AI data center
notes: PV Magazine reports Jinko Power signed a framework agreement with Zhongwei for a 1 GW data center under Eastern Data Western Computing; approvals/funding still pending, so status is planned.

name: Zhongjiao Zhishugu (Ningxia-Zhongwei) Industrial Park
notes: Industry park press reports the Zhongjiao Zhishugu (Ningxia-Zhongwei) industrial park opened for operation shortly after the 2026 Spring Festival, part of Zhongwei's green-computing hub buildout; capacity details not published.

name: Silk Cloud Valley Qinghai-Haidong Low-Carbon Computing Industrial Park Phase I
developer: Chongqing Yizhong Digital Energy / Qinghai Yizhong Digital Energy with Haidong partners
notes: Haidong Industrial Park reports the RMB23bn phase-one project in Qinghai Zero-Carbon Industrial Park was launched in November 2023 and due to complete in September 2025, centered on cloud computing, big data centers, and waste-heat reuse.

name: Haidong green computing cluster (China Mobile, China Telecom, Kingsoft Cloud, Cambricon, Shenzhen Yuyang, Xiaomi projects)
notes: Haidong Industrial Park states Haidong has 14 completed green-computing projects with RMB7.394bn invested, six under construction, six newly signed, including China Mobile and China Telecom big-data centers plus Kingsoft Cloud, Cambricon, Shenzhen Yuyang and Xiaomi projects; 2025-03 press reports about RMB4bn in new Haidong green-computing signing intents.

name: Hainan Prefecture Clean Energy Big Data Industry Demonstration Base
developer: Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture with Huawei Digital Power technology support
notes: Huawei Digital Power case study describes a Hainan Prefecture clean-energy data center park with planned area of 800,000 square meters aiming to become a clean-energy big-data demonstration base.

name: Wanjie Jingfeng Qinghai Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Hainan Prefecture government reports the RMB4bn Wanjie Jingfeng Qinghai Intelligent Computing Center has started construction, planned for 9,338 standard racks and 11,000P computing scale, one of 17 filed computing projects in the prefecture.

name: Guancheng Technology Green Computing Center
notes: Hainan Prefecture government says Guancheng Technology and other projects were signed during the Qinghai investment fair, totaling RMB1.004bn, for high-density liquid-cooled intelligent-computing clusters with dedicated green-power lines and over 4,608P computing scale.

name: Haidai Zhisuan Delingha Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Qinghai Intelligent Computing Technology Co. (Haidai Zhisuan)
notes: Regional press reports the Delingha intelligent computing center project in Haixi Prefecture's green industrial park topped out main structure in September 2025; ~RMB1.2bn investment, ~41 mu site; phase II No.3 data center construction tender announced March 2026 with ~RMB1.5bn budget.

name: Haixi Prefecture Big Data Industrial Park Data Center Phase I
developer: Qinghai Yuse Network Technology Co. Ltd.
notes: Qinghai government service site reports phase one was under construction after July 2023 start, covers 8.487 ha, integrates AI supercomputing clusters, large-model training, and mass storage/backup, targeted operation by end-2024.

name: Huangnan Prefecture Qianfan Large-Model Green Computing Infrastructure Project
notes: Aggregate project-tracking source reports the RMB1.7bn Huangnan Prefecture Qianfan large-model green computing infrastructure project was filed (beian) 2025-07-08; weak/aggregate evidence, not yet verified from an official filing page.

name: Xining Intelligent Computing Center (Guancheng Technology Green Computing Center)
notes: Xining Intelligent Computing Center signed 2026-03-23 at Xining (national) ETDZ Nanchuan Industrial Park, total investment RMB0.95bn, converting ~3,000 sqm of China Mobile machine room, planning 10,000P Flops (phase one 5,000P); first 'Jing-Shu-Qing-Suan' green-computing flagship; CSCEC 8th Bureau won construction tender June 2026.

name: Qinghai Green Power Intelligent Computing Industrial Park / Sanjiangyuan National Big Data Center Phase II-III
developer: China Unicom Qinghai and Xining Economic-Technological Development Zone partners
notes: Qinghai government service site reports Xining Development Zone signed a RMB1.77bn green intelligent-computing industrial park project, mainly building Sanjiangyuan National Big Data Center phase II and III on about 30 mu.

name: Qinghai Sanjiangyuan National Green Intelligent Computing Dispatch Platform
developer: Zhongbei Communications Group and Xining Economic-Technological Development Zone partners
notes: Qinghai government service site reports a RMB1bn project for a large-scale ten-thousand-card-class compute dispatch platform in Xining, planned to reach 5,000P FLOPS after completion.

name: China Unicom Qinghai/Xining AI data center
notes: Data Centre Magazine reports China Unicom opened a Xining, Qinghai AI data center using 23,000 domestic AI chips and about US$390m investment; precise MW not stated.

name: Qinghai salt lake data center, Xining
developer: Salt Lakes Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences
notes: China MEE English site reported Qinghai planned an eight-year, RMB90m salt-lake data center in Xining to support salt-lake resource planning; current operational status not confirmed.

name: Ankang Internet Data Center project, Ankang High-Tech Zone
developer: Ankang High-Tech Zone / investment promotion project
notes: Ankang investment promotion bureau lists a planned 80,000 square meter Ankang Internet Data Center to support Digital High-Tech Zone development; capacity not stated.

name: Ankang Intelligent Computing Center project
notes: Ankang municipal coverage calls for advancing the Ankang intelligent computing center project; a municipal digital-economy article also proposed building an Ankang supercomputing center using local hydropower and climate advantages.

name: Baoji Mobile Big Data Center / China Mobile cloud-computing data center
notes: Provincial reporting describes Baoji Mobile Big Data Center as the largest data center in western China running more than 100,000 servers; earlier trade coverage describes a China Mobile Baoji cloud-computing data center project with reported total investment of CNY 8 billion.

name: Smart Hantai Big Data Center
notes: Guangming Daily/Guangming tech coverage says the Smart Hantai big data center is a standard Class B data center with private-cloud virtualized servers and ongoing municipal-district digital services.

name: Shangluo City Big Data Center
notes: Shaanxi provincial reporting says Shangluo City Big Data Center was completed and put into service, providing unified citywide government data sharing and exchange infrastructure.

name: Tongchuan Big Data Center
notes: Tongchuan government describes the Tongchuan big data center as the city's unified e-government cloud/data resource platform built to second-grade equal-protection standards.

name: Huashan Cloud Data Center
developer: Shaanxi Huashan Cloud Data Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Trade coverage reports the Huashan Cloud Data Center started construction in April 2025, achieved first-phase operation within nine months, and was certified as a national Class A data center with reported investment above CNY 150 million.

name: Xi'an Future AI Computing Center
notes: Titan Media visited Xi'an Future AI Computing Center, described as the first large-scale AI computing cluster in northwest China built on Ascend (Shengteng) hardware; MW not disclosed.

name: National Supercomputing Xi'an Center
developer: National Supercomputing Xi'an Center / Xi'an Future AI Computing Center partners
notes: The National Supercomputing Xi'an Center describes its campus as a high-performance computing center with data-center and supporting R&D/living facilities, including a total construction area of about 53,700 square meters.

name: China Unicom Xi'an Data Center
notes: Xinhua coverage of Shaanxi digital infrastructure identifies China Unicom's Xi'an data center among local intelligent-computing/data-center infrastructure; trade coverage reports a planned scale around 30,000 standard racks and about CNY 3 billion investment.

name: Xi'an Fengzhu Data Center Project
developer: Fengzhu Data Center project company / local high-tech zone partners
notes: Trade coverage reports the Xi'an Fengzhu Data Center project as a CNY 320 million data-center construction project; direct MW was not disclosed.

name: China Mobile Shaanxi Xixian New Area Data Center
notes: Shaanxi provincial reporting says China Mobile's Xixian New Area data center is a national green data center with a planned capacity of about 18,000 racks and more than 300,000 servers; classified under Xianyang because Xixian spans Xi'an-Xianyang.

name: Yan'an Cloud Computing Data Center
notes: Yan'an government coverage references the Yan'an Cloud Computing Data Center as a local digital economy/cloud computing facility supporting government cloud and data-resource activity.

name: Yulin Huawei Cloud Computing Data Center / Energy Big Data Center
developer: Yulin municipal government and Huawei ecosystem partners
notes: Yulin government and trade coverage describe Huawei/Shaanxi Coal cloud and energy big-data facilities in Yulin, including cloud-computing and energy-data services; no direct MW figure was reported.

name: Binzhou City Big Data Center
notes: Binzhou government coverage identifies the city big data center as local data infrastructure supporting digital-government and public-data platforms; no MW figure was disclosed.
